Omitting these non-topological proposition attempts therefore removes no currently required structure-detection input. Their exact statements remain trusted explanatory material, although they do not drive graph topology or structural strategy selection.
architecture_analysis.core_distinction: A source-supported statement does not require a typed edge or proposition unless the compiler needs that topology to preserve or select a representation.

execution_statement: The semantic diagnosis used only immutable committed repository evidence.
